generic_safe_decision_policy_baseline.description: Assess situation → prioritize safety → identify lawful options → choose proportionate action → escalate if repeated or high risk → document when useful.
dpt_r_mandatory_additions: D02 imposed-role hypothesis (not FACT without support)
D07 dignity-invariance (worth ≠ harm received; REPORT/SEEK_HELP ≠ dignity failure)
D08 non-mimetic control (organizing telos ≠ mirror/revenge script)
generic_safe_decision_policy_baseline.collapse_risk: Checks can be marked not_run or pass trivially if D02 fires on every friction event or D08 defers to post-hoc justification.

attacks.probe: Lawful manager gives critical performance feedback with deadline; no humiliation script.
attacks.design_read: D02 requires social/agentive assignment + closed choice-set. Support may be absent → D10/D04 only.
attacks.failure_mode: Misreader treats deadline + hierarchy as SUBORDINATE role assignment.

attacks.probe: Creditor requests agreed payment schedule; debtor feels shame.
attacks.design_read: D02: not merely hard constraint. Debt accountability ≠ R_imposed if no agency-capture script.
attacks.failure_mode: DEBTOR_WITHOUT_AGENCY candidate over-triggered without humiliation/closed binary.

attacks.probe: Peer disagreement in study group; no authority, no closed binary.
attacks.design_read: D02 support missing → no creative-resistance steps.
attacks.failure_mode: observed_coercive_frame field invites over-labeling ordinary disagreement as capture.

attacks.probe: Parent sets bedtime boundary for child (lawful care).
attacks.design_read: Spec §5.1.3: constraint ≠ R_imposed. Design inherits via locked concepts.
attacks.failure_mode: None at design ceiling if D02 read with constraint firewall.

attacks.probe: Economic threat: 'Comply or lose housing' without insults.
attacks.design_read: D04 table lacks economic-coercion row; D02 may miss without explicit humiliation script.
attacks.failure_mode: Coercion classified as hard constraint only → under-detection.

attacks.probe: Reputational threat: quiet smear campaign, no overt aggression.
attacks.design_read: No reputational-threat pattern in D02/D04.
attacks.failure_mode: Overt-aggression bias in illustrative probes (S2).

attacks.probe: Dependency coercion (visa sponsor, caregiver control).
attacks.design_read: Authority asymmetry not enumerated; repeated pattern in D04 helps only after physical contact row.
attacks.failure_mode: Subtle capture without physical contact under-detected.

attacks.probe: Repeated harassment with escalating insults (S2 class).
attacks.design_read: D04 repeated coercion + S2 probe.
attacks.failure_mode: None at design level.

attacks.probe: Workplace 'endure or quit' frame (S1 class).
attacks.design_read: S1 + D02 closed binary.
attacks.failure_mode: None at design level.

attacks.probe: Domestic violence immediate threat.
attacks.design_read: D04 row 1: EXIT/SEEK_HELP/PROTECT/DEFEND outrank symbolic resistance.
attacks.failure_mode: None if D04 read before D06-D08.

attacks.probe: Stalking with unknown location safety.
attacks.design_read: D11: safety cannot be assessed → STOP/ABSTAIN; D04 when assessable favors EXIT/REPORT.
attacks.failure_mode: None at design ceiling.

attacks.probe: Workplace retaliation risk after REPORT.
attacks.design_read: D04 lacks retaliation-risk row; EXPOSE_COERCION admissible without unsafe-exposure guard.
attacks.failure_mode: Symbolic exposure or boundary-only path may delay formal REPORT when retaliation risk is primary.

attacks.probe: Unsafe public exposure demanded as 'courage'.
attacks.design_read: EXPOSE_COERCION in action set; D04 does not forbid exposure when visibility unsafe.
attacks.failure_mode: Dignity/non-mimetic narrative could privilege visible resistance over EXIT.

attacks.probe: Vulnerable third party in same room.
attacks.design_read: D04: PROTECT/REPORT outrank agent non-mimetic performance.
attacks.failure_mode: None at design level.

attacks.probe: Conflicting accounts; action depends on who started it.
attacks.design_read: D03 + D11: ABSTAIN/DEFER; no historical reconstruction as FACT.
attacks.failure_mode: None.

attacks.probe: Religious certainty vs unresolved evidence.
attacks.design_read: D03: telos must not override evidence.
attacks.failure_mode: None at design level.

attacks.probe: Legal context unknown where legally material.
attacks.design_read: D11 fail-closed; not a legal-advice engine.
attacks.failure_mode: None.

attacks.probe: Harassment claim with incomplete evidence (probe variation).
attacks.design_read: Safety may still require EXIT without treating allegation as FACT; D03 limits punitive unique action.
attacks.failure_mode: None — design separates safety-first from fact adjudication.

attacks.probe: Same physical pushback: motive A protective vs motive B revenge.
attacks.design_read: D08: organizing telos revenge/humiliation-return = fail.
attacks.failure_mode: Post-hoc 'independently justified' without D09 record discipline.

attacks.probe: DEFEND_WHEN_JUSTIFIED surface-mirrors opponent strike.
attacks.design_read: Exception allowed if independently justified.
attacks.failure_mode: Without operational justification checklist, NON_MIMETIC unfalsifiable at design-only layer.

attacks.probe: WITHDRAW labeled non-mimetic vs COOPERATE labeled mimetic without script analysis.
attacks.design_read: D08 default ≠ Mirror(opponent_action); withdrawal is not mirror by definition.
attacks.failure_mode: None if D06/D08 read together.

attacks.probe: Revenge framed as dignity restoration.
attacks.design_read: D08 fail: revenge as organizing telos.
attacks.failure_mode: D07 alone does not name revenge; relies on D08 coupling.

attacks.probe: Refusal of lawful accountability ('I won't apologize; that lowers dignity').
attacks.design_read: D07 pass/fail focuses on harm-received worth collapse, not accountability refusal.
attacks.failure_mode: Dignity language can block lawful authority/accountability.

attacks.probe: Grandiose escalation to 'prove' worth after insult.
attacks.design_read: D08 'prove strength' fail.
attacks.failure_mode: Partial — needs explicit ego-defense row.

attacks.probe: REPORT/SEEK_HELP treated as shameful.
attacks.design_read: D07 explicit fail if REPORT/SEEK_HELP treated as dignity failure.
attacks.failure_mode: None.

axis_attacks.name: ACTION_SET_OVERBREADTH

attacks.probe: Compare to GENERIC_SAFE_DECISION_POLICY on S2 harassment.
attacks.design_read: Generic also yields EXIT/REPORT. DPT-R adds D02/D06/D07/D08 mandatory record fields.
attacks.failure_mode: Marginal delta if checks marked not_run.

attacks.probe: Low-risk pressure S3 where COOPERATE is best.
attacks.design_read: D05: COOPERATE admissible; S3 excludes unnecessary emergency REPORT.
attacks.failure_mode: None — not collapsed to one stereotype.

attacks.probe: Can protocol skip imposed-role assessment when safety dominates?
attacks.design_read: D02: missing support → D04 without full role model allowed.
attacks.failure_mode: Risk of skipping DPT-R identity entirely on safety path — acceptable if recorded.

axis_attacks.nonvacuity_rationale: Structural mandatory gates D02/D06/D07/D08 + D09 record distinguish from generic safe policy; distinctiveness weakens if D02 over-fires or checks are not_run.

variations.variation: Same workplace instruction but lawful/legitimate (performance plan).
variations.expected: D02 support absent or weak → no role-refusal theater; DOCUMENT/COOPERATE admissible.
D03/D11 constrain fact-dependent punitive action; D04 still allows safety EXIT.

variations.variation: Cooperation is actually best (group project deadline).
variations.expected: COOPERATE admissible; no S2 safety stack.
D11 fail-closed SEEK_COUNSEL; no invented legal strategy.

gap_register.summary: D02 lacks explicit negative examples for lawful instruction, accountability, ordinary disagreement.
Subtle coercion modes (economic, reputational, dependency) not enumerated in D02/D04.
Workplace retaliation risk and unsafe public exposure not guarded against EXPOSE/boundary-only delay.
D08 independent-justification criterion qualitative; post-hoc labeling risk without D09 enforcement.
D07 does not block dignity-as-entitlement against lawful accountability.
PROTOCOL_NONVACUITY marginal if D09 checks routinely not_run on safety-fast-path.
NON_MIMETIC falsifiability requires runtime justification record — not testable at design-only layer.

required_narrowing_not_applied: Add explicit lawful-instruction / accountability / ordinary-friction negatives to imposed-role detection (future spec revision only).
Add subtle-coercion pattern hooks (economic, reputational, dependency) without inventing numeric thresholds.
Add retaliation-risk and unsafe-exposure guards before EXPOSE_COERCION prominence.
Bind dignity check to accountability compatibility and D08 revenge/ego telos.
Require D09 nonvacuity fields on any non-ABSTAIN output (future bounded spec).

claim_ceiling.pass_means: Design survived bounded adversarial review without implementation; PROTOCOL_NONVACUITY TRUE_WITH_NARROWING.
